title: Chuk Chuk Train | Wait Your Turn Song for Kids | Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A cheerful train song that teaches little ones to wait their turn and line up one by one.
Kids learn about sharing the station, not pushing, and waving goodbye to friends.
Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers who love toots, chuk chuk sounds, and bouncy tunes.

Chuk chuk, here comes the train
Stopping at the station now
Toot toot, toot toot
Everybody, look at me!

Chuk chuk train is on its way
Wait, don't push and don't grab
Chuk chuk, chuk chuk
Wait your turn, then hop on board!

Push push, let's all go
Everyone is at the door
Thud thud, thud thud
Oh, too many, wait a bit!

Chuk chuk train is on its way
Wait, don't push and don't grab
Chuk chuk, chuk chuk
Wait your turn, then hop on board!

Little sister, brother, stand in line
One by one, one by one
Tick tock, tick tock
A line of friends, hooray!

Chuk chuk train is on its way
Wait, don't push and don't grab
Chuk chuk, chuk chuk
Wait your turn, then hop on board!

Amma waves, "Bye bye, train!"
The children wave goodbye too
Chuk chuk, chuk chuk, chuk chuk
See you soon, bye bye!
